title: Remove audio + photo features/sections from anniversary site (frontend-only)

requirements.summary: Remove the background music UI and all audio playback logic/asset references from the runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: The MusicPlayer component is not rendered anywhere in the app.
The app no longer references or requires any audio asset paths under /assets/audio/ (directly or via config).
There are no remaining user-facing audio controls (play/pause/volume/mute) in the UI.

file_operations.description: Remove MusicPlayer import and rendering so no audio player UI is mounted anywhere; ensure no leftover audio-related UI controls remain.
Delete the MusicPlayer component implementation so no audio playback logic ships in the frontend bundle.
Remove the music/audio configuration block and any inline audio setup instructions so the app no longer references /assets/audio/ paths.

requirements.summary: Remove the Photo Gallery section and all gallery-driven lightbox interactions, including navbar/scroll-spy references.
acceptanceCriteria: The Gallery section is not rendered in the page flow.
The navbar/scroll-spy no longer includes a Gallery entry/section id and does not track it.
No lightbox/modal is opened from gallery interactions because gallery interactions are removed.

file_operations.description: Remove GallerySection import and rendering from the page flow, and update the scroll-spy section list to exclude the gallery section id.
Remove the 'gallery' nav item so the navbar no longer includes or scrolls to the Gallery section.
Delete the Gallery section implementation (grid + click-to-open lightbox) so no gallery interactions remain.
Remove the shared image lightbox dialog since gallery/lightbox interactions are being removed (and it will no longer be used after letter removal as well).

requirements.summary: Remove the framed hero photo so the Hero section renders without any photo or gallery-sourced image references.
acceptanceCriteria: The Hero section renders without any photo/image that was previously displayed as the framed hero photo.
The app does not reference the hero photo path (e.g., /assets/gallery/then-and-now.jpg) anymore.

file_operations.description: Remove FramedPhoto usage and the hero image asset reference so the hero displays only the existing text content.
Delete the FramedPhoto component since the hero framed photo is removed and it should no longer be referenced anywhere.

requirements.summary: Remove the handwritten letter image preview and letter lightbox from the Family Messages section so only text messages remain.
acceptanceCriteria: The Messages section does not render any handwritten letter image preview button.
The Messages section does not open a lightbox/modal for a handwritten letter image.
The app no longer references or requires any letter image asset paths under /assets/letters/.

file_operations.description: Remove handwritten letter rendering, the image preview button, and the letter lightbox state/trigger so the section contains only the text-based messages.
Remove handwritten letter configuration (and any /assets/letters/ paths) so no letter image assets are referenced by the app.

requirements.summary: Update the centralized anniversary configuration to remove photo/audio fields and related inline instructions now that those features are removed.
acceptanceCriteria: The configuration no longer contains photo gallery instructions or gallery dataset entries if they are not used by the app.
The configuration no longer contains handwritten letter image configuration if it is not used by the app.
The configuration no longer contains music/audio configuration if it is not used by the app.
The frontend builds successfully with no unused/invalid references caused by removing these config fields.

file_operations.description: Remove photo gallery instructions and data, remove handwritten letter image config, and remove music/audio config; ensure remaining content shape matches what the UI now consumes.
Confirm App references only remaining config fields after config cleanup (and ensure the app compiles cleanly without removed photo/audio fields).
